paragraphs.title: Establishing the Musicians’ Divisions and Their Role

answers: David and the captains of the host
easy.explanation: Verse 1 says that David and the captains of the host separated them to the service.
easy.q: Who separated the musicians for service?

easy.explanation: The passage names the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun.
easy.q: Which three families of musicians are named?

easy.explanation: The musicians were to prophesy with harps, psalteries, and cymbals.
easy.q: What instruments are mentioned in verse 1?

answers: He guarded the gates of the house of God
He prophesied with a harp to give thanks and praise the LORD
He counted the musicians in each division
medium.explanation: Verse 3 says Jeduthun prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
Verse 7 gives the number as two hundred fourscore and eight, or 288.
medium.q: How many were instructed and skilled in the songs of the LORD?

medium.explanation: The phrase describes musicians who had been trained in the songs of the LORD.
medium.q: What does “instructed in the songs” most nearly mean?

answers: The divisions were assigned without favoring the great over the small
Only the greatest musicians received divisions
The youngest musicians were chosen first
challenge.explanation: The wording emphasizes that both the small and the great were included fairly.
challenge.q: What principle is expressed by casting lots “as well the small as the great”?

answers: The sons served separately from their fathers
The fathers and their sons served together in the musical ministry
Only the fathers were responsible for the songs
challenge.explanation: The passage repeatedly describes the sons serving under the hands of their fathers.
challenge.q: What relationship between fathers and sons is emphasized in the passage?

answers: There were only a few musicians
There was a large group of trained and capable musicians
challenge.explanation: The number two hundred fourscore and eight refers to those instructed and skilled in the songs.
challenge.q: What does the number 288 indicate about the musicians?

short_answers.question: What was the purpose of the musicians’ service in the house of the LORD?
short_answers.answer: They served with musical instruments in the worship and service of the house of God.
short_answers.explanation: Verse 6 connects their music with the service of the house of God.

paragraphs.title: The First Lots and the Groups of Twelve

easy.explanation: The first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph.
The second lot was assigned to Gedaliah.
The verses repeatedly state that each man, his sons, and his brethren were twelve.
easy.q: How many sons and brethren were in each division mentioned?

medium.explanation: The first three lots went to Joseph, Gedaliah, and Zaccur.
medium.q: What is the correct order of the first three lots?

answers: A means of determining the order of the divisions
medium.explanation: Lots were cast to establish the order of service.
medium.q: In this passage, what does “lot” refer to?

medium.explanation: Verse 13 identifies Bukkiah as the recipient of the sixth lot.

answers: Each is described as having twelve sons and brethren
challenge.explanation: The description of twelve sons and brethren is repeated for each division.
challenge.q: What do the divisions from the first through the ninth have in common?

challenge.explanation: Mattaniah received the ninth lot and is the final name in verses 9–16.
challenge.q: Which name ends the sequence of lots in this section?

answers: The divisions were arranged in an organized order
The names were written without any order
Only the family of Asaph served
challenge.explanation: The numbered lots present a deliberate order for the divisions.
challenge.q: What does the numbered presentation of the names show?

short_answers.question: What was common to the divisions listed in verses 9–16?
short_answers.answer: Each division was described as consisting of twelve sons and brethren.
short_answers.explanation: This statement is repeated throughout the list of the first nine lots.

easy.explanation: The tenth lot came forth to Shimei.
Romamti-ezer received the four and twentieth, or twenty-fourth, lot.
easy.q: Who received the four and twentieth lot?

answers: A group or division assigned to a particular service
medium.explanation: The word refers to an assigned division or order of service.
medium.q: What does “ward” mean in the context of these verses?

medium.explanation: Mattaniah is ninth, and Azareel is listed as the eleventh after Shimei.
medium.q: Which name comes after Mattaniah in the complete list?

medium.explanation: Counting inclusively from the tenth through the twenty-fourth gives fifteen lots.
medium.q: How many lots are included from the tenth through the twenty-fourth?

answers: Each is described as having twelve sons and brethren
Each includes fourteen sons and three daughters
Only the last lot includes a family
challenge.explanation: The phrase stating that the sons and brethren were twelve is repeated for every lot.
challenge.q: What do all the lots from the tenth through the twenty-fourth have in common?

challenge.explanation: The twenty-second, twenty-third, and twenty-fourth lots were Giddalti, Mahazioth, and Romamti-ezer.
challenge.q: Which is the correct order of the final three lots?

answers: The list stops before it is complete
The musical service was organized into twenty-four divisions
There were only ten divisions in total
challenge.explanation: The continuous numbering ends at twenty-four, showing the completed arrangement of the divisions.
challenge.q: What does the numbering through the four and twentieth lot show?

short_answers.question: What number of divisions does the full list contain?
short_answers.answer: The full list contains twenty-four divisions.
short_answers.explanation: The final entry is identified as the four and twentieth lot.
